# `armada server`

<!-- Generated by `make docs` from the commands; do not edit. -->

[All commands](armada.md)

List and delete control plane servers, and create tokens that add them.
A server runs on its machine with `armadad server`, and joins with
`armadad server join`.

Also: `servers`.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`armada server delete`](#armada-server-delete) | Delete a control plane server |
| [`armada server join-token`](#armada-server-join-token) | Create a single-use token that adds a control plane server, and print the join command |
| [`armada server list`](#armada-server-list) | List control plane servers and update the client config with them |

## `armada server delete`

Delete a control plane server from the cluster. Stop `armadad server` on it first.
Its agent stays a node; delete that with `armada node delete`. The leader cannot
delete itself: stop it, and run this once another server leads.

A removed server still holds copies of the cluster CA key and master key: wipe
its data directory.

```
armada server delete NAME
```

Also: `rm`.

## `armada server join-token`

Create a single-use join token and print the command to run on the new node.

The token is a credential: anyone holding it before it expires can add a node.
Send it over a trusted channel. Only a hash is stored on the server.

A server token hands the new server the cluster CA key and the secrets master
key: it lasts 15 minutes by default and at most an hour.

```
armada server join-token [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--label stringArray` | label KEY=VALUE for the node that joins with the token (repeatable) |
| `--ttl duration` | token lifetime (1m to 1h) (default `15m0s`) |

## `armada server list`

List control plane servers and update the client config with them.

```
armada server list [flags]
```

Also: `ls`.

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--output string` | output format: text or json (default `text`) |
